protocol.configuration_selection: fixed defaults before measurements; no performance tuning
protocol.image_holdout: different catalog view; byte and decoded-pixel exclusion against every indexed image; also exclude query pixels shared by multiple catalog products; product identities remain in catalog
protocol.latency: local warm serial requests; retrieval-only and encoding-inclusive reported separately; no network or production load
protocol.population: exploratory development benchmark; not a frozen final test

text_ground_truth.labels: binary exact conjunction of product_type and supplied English attributes
text_ground_truth.rule: most specific valid attribute group per product, lexicographic ties; deduplicate identical queries

protocol.ties: NumPy score then product_id; FAISS returned scores then product_id (boundary ties use FAISS membership)
protocol.vector_representation: one normalized pretrained image embedding per product; text queries search that image index
